info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Account Management Reward Points Account-spec
info.description: The Account Management Reward Points API facilitates the creation of reward points accounts for customers within the banking system. This service allows businesses to manage customer loyalty and reward programs effectively. Through this endpoint, developers can initiate new accounts that customers can use to accumulate and redeem reward points. Typical consumers include financial institutions and customer loyalty program providers looking to streamline their account management processes.

post.summary: Create a new reward points account
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new reward points account, enabling them to accumulate and manage reward points effectively. It is essential for customer engagement and loyalty programs.
